Happy Thanksgiving! 🙏🏾 Thank Him in advance. Your pain will become your praise.
What are you thanking God for today? Tell me below and I'll pray with you.

🔥 THE FIRE FELL IN NASHVILLE — Deliverance Crusade 2026

The house rose as one, the Word went forth, and chains fell at "Solution Ground." Swipe through the night heaven touched Nashville.

"Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD." — Jeremiah 23:29

📸 Relive it all in the full gallery: mfmmegaregion2usa.org/gallery-nashville-2026
🎬 Premiering this morning at 8:30 AM CT. There is no live stream today, but I have a new word for you. Come expecting, and drop your prayer request in the premiere chat. I'll be praying with you. 🙏🏾

Tomorrow at 8:30 AM CT, a new word premieres right here on the channel. 🙌🏾 Set a reminder on the premiere, bring someone with you, and join me in the chat.
What do you want me to pray with you about tomorrow? Tell me below 👇🏾

"My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations." (James 1:2) 🙏🏾
This is Thanksgiving week. Even in your pain, there is something to thank God for. What are you thankful for today? Tell me in the comments.
🗓️ A new message premieres this Wednesday at 8:30 AM CT right here. Turn on notifications 🔔

A note from my heart ✍🏾
Beloved, your pain is not the end of your story. God has not forgotten you, and He has a purpose in what you are going through. Don't give up. Your pain will turn to gain.
— Pastor Olumide

My prayer sheet for this week 🙏🏾 Save it and pray these six prayer points out loud every day. Type AMEN as you pray, and when God answers, come back and share your testimony with me.
▶️ Full message: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EE18n...

Pain will show you who your real friends are. When everything is going smoothly, you may not know the true colour of the people around you. But when there is pain, the real ones remain. 🙏🏾
Who stayed with you in your hardest season? Thank them today, and tell me about them below 👇🏾
▶️ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EE18n...
